description: A PERSONAL MESSAGE FROM VICTOR Every victory we see in this campaign is exciting—but more than that, it’s confirmation we’re exactly where we’re supposed to be. Are we facing resistance? Absolutely. But that comes with the territory. The closer you get to the target, the more opposition shows up. And while I don’t take lightly calling anyone an enemy, the attacks we’re seeing—and those backing them—have made it clear: this is a fight. Here’s the truth… nothing they throw at us is going to stop
title: TEAM VICTOR WEEKLY TEAM UPDATE March 22, 2026
